requirements.text: Document C-GATE-15 so every needs_human_confirmation gate must notify the responsible requester with a member mention and clear unblock conditions.
Record VH-23 as feedback evidence that waiting_on and blocked_reason alone are not human-visible notification.
Keep PR #19 linkable to B2B-71 and explain the B2B-101/B2B-102 feedback chain without close intent.

design.summary: This low-risk iteration adds durable documentation evidence for the B2B-71 feedback loop and keeps PR #19 discoverable by Multica issue linking. The code surface is unchanged; verification relies on the existing SHK quality gate test suite plus explicit spec and mutation evidence.

risk_points.text: The rule could describe waiting metadata but fail to require an actual member mention to the accountable human.
PR #19 could remain invisible to Multica if B2B-71 is absent from the PR title/body/branch-visible metadata.
Verification can regress to NOT_READY if the iteration spec or evidence mapping is absent.

traffic_flows.name: comment-only mutation evidence is rejected
traffic_flows.entrypoint: fake E2E, missing spec, comment-only mutation and mutated app are blocked
steps: A feedback item reports that a needs-human gate is not visible to the requester.
C-GATE-15 is added to require owner identification, member mention, decision options, unblock conditions, and fallback handling.
VH-23 records the user-visible failure mode and maps it back to C-GATE-15.
Release and dogfood notes describe the same notification requirement without changing runtime code.

traffic_flows.name: contract-backed E2E is accepted
traffic_flows.entrypoint: install/init E2E and contract-backed target app E2E pass
steps: PR #19 metadata includes B2B-71 so Multica can link the PR to the parent feedback issue.
The PR body explains that B2B-101 and B2B-102 are the feedback and verification child issues.
The wording avoids Closes/Fixes/Resolves close intent for B2B-71.

test_plan.scenario: Run the existing SHK regression suite after the documentation update.
assertions: node tests/run.js passes with no failed tests.
The suite still rejects weak quality-gate evidence and preserves C-GATE/VH documentation contracts.

test_plan.scenario: Run shk spec status for this low-risk iteration.
assertions: The iteration spec exists and evaluates READY.
Every must requirement, risk point, traffic flow, test plan item, and acceptance item has an explicit mapping.

test_plan.scenario: Run shk test effectiveness after spec and mutation evidence are present.
assertions: The report is not NOT_READY for missing .harness/iteration-spec.json.
The report has structured mutation/fault evidence with killed > 0 and survived === 0.
The generated E2E evidence covers the spec traffic flows.
The PR does not introduce whitespace errors in tracked files.

acceptance.text: C-GATE-15 and VH-23 remain documented as the durable rule and feedback evidence for human-confirmation notification.
PR #19 contains B2B-71 and explains the B2B-101/B2B-102 feedback chain without close intent.
